title: tilia pubescens f. truncata
intro: Tilia pubescens f. truncata, commonly known as the Dwarf Tilia or Tilia truncata, is a subspecies of the Tilia pubescens tree, known for its unique trunk shape and small leaves. The Dwarf Tilia is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, anxiety, and stress, and improving sleep quality. Its therapeutic actions include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and anxiolytic properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are known to interact with the body's GABA receptors to produce a calming effect. The bioactive constituents of the Dwarf Tilia also exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, further contributing to its medicinal properties.
